name: burrow-go-test
description: First-class Go tests for Burrow (architecture task 11): a native Test Explorer populated by scanning the workspace for `func Test*`/`Benchmark*`/`Fuzz*`/`Example*`, with real `go test -run <name> -json ./<pkg>` execution reporting pass/fail live into the test UI. First slice — discovery + run; coverage, bench history, fuzz corpus, watch mode and debug come later.

scripts.test: node test/discovery.test.js && node test/command.test.js && node test/events.test.js

burrow.test.goExecutable.description: Path to the `go` binary used to discover and run tests.

burrow.test.race.description: Run every test with the race detector (`-race`), honoring the scheme bar's race toggle.
